principles: Ground truth is created before reviewers can inspect ThisTinti output for the blind case.
Evidence, extracted facts, interpretations and human judgments remain distinct.
Presence and evidentiary sufficiency are independent dimensions.
Financial impact type and financial status are independent dimensions.
Document-declared dates are not silently promoted to real-world events.
Every fact references evidence; every interpretation references facts and a rule.

fallback_review.requirement: The limitation must be explicit in the Pilot Manifest and final report; independence must never be fabricated.
